items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: I got through my military service fortunately and came home and went back with Gap and then went out with Woody’s band.

ctx.x: But then you replaced him in 1968 with Gap Mangione?

Yes. I took his place when he enlisted in the army, I took that gig, which only lasted a matter of months because I was drafted very quickly. This was 1968, right? But I got through my military service fortunately and came home and went back with Gap and then went out with Woody’s band.
